description.value: Prinkle Chicken is a Korean-style fried chicken chain with multiple BC locations, specializing in hand-battered, deep-fried chicken hand-brushed with Korean sauces such as yangyeom, honey hot, and their signature 'prinkle snow.' The menu also features Korean street-food sides like tteokbokki and cheese balls. The Granville Street location is one of several Vancouver outposts of this growing BC franchise.
